{
  "technical_and_design_decisions": [
    "Target platform is Spring XD (eXtended Data) running on the JVM, with ported modules targeting the spring-cloud-stream (s-c-s) repository.",
    "Reuse existing Spring XD module/options metadata model for the Cassandra and analytic-pmml modules to minimize behavioral drift during the port.",
    "Implement multiple-bindings-per-type (U1) by extending the binder configuration model to allow named, distinct binder instances bound to the same input/output contract, with channel resolution at runtime.",
    "For HDFS HA (U2), replace NameNodeProxies.createNonHAProxy with a HA-aware proxy that reads nameservice IDs from core-site.xml and uses HDFS HA RPC failover; keep the legacy non-HA path as a fallback.",
    "Job-composition REST endpoints (U5, U6) are added to the Spring XD Admin REST controller layer using Spring MVC, returning JSON; U6 returns an adjacency-list representation of the composed job graph.",
    "UI changes (U7, U8) are implemented in the existing XD Admin UI (AngularJS-based) and reuse the existing job-list/job-detail view templates; no new UI framework is introduced.",
    "Testing strategy: JUnit + Mockito for unit tests, Spring XD test harness for integration tests, and Selenium-style smoke tests for the UI changes.",
    "Build system assumed to be Maven (consistent with Spring XD/s-c-s conventions).",
    "All eight user stories are independent and can be developed in parallel by a single developer sequentially; no cross-story refactoring is assumed unless explicitly noted (e.g., U5/U6 share a DTO).",
    "No production deployment, infrastructure provisioning, or DevOps pipeline work is included in the scope."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "A single full-time developer performs all work; 1 work-hour equals 1 wall-clock hour of focused development.",
    "Existing Spring XD source tree, s-c-s source tree, and CI infrastructure are available and not part of the increment.",
    "Cassandra (U3) and analytic-pmml (U4) modules already exist in XD and are functionally stable; the work is a code move, dependency re-alignment, and re-test, not a re-implementation.",
    "PMML evaluation engine (e.g., JPMML) is reused as-is in the ported analytic-pmml module; no new PMML features are added.",
    "The job composition graph (U6) is bounded to a single composed job's direct parent/children and one level of nesting; recursive traversal is not required for the first increment.",
    "The REST endpoints in U5/U6 are read-only; no mutation or composition management is included.",
    "Visual differentiation in U7 uses color/iconography cues within the existing UI palette and does not require a new design system.",
    "The 'detail page' referenced in U8 already exists for both standalone and composed jobs; U8 only fixes routing/navigation so the correct page is rendered from either entry point.",
    "No production-grade performance testing, load testing, or security hardening is included beyond standard unit/integration coverage.",
    "Code reviews, merging, and minor build fixes are folded into the per-activity effort rather than tracked separately."
  ],
  "activities": [
    {
      "activity_id": "A1",
      "activity_name": "Requirements analysis and technical design",
      "activity_description": "Review all 8 user stories, study the relevant Spring XD / s-c-s code paths (binder config, HDFS module location, Admin REST, Admin UI, Cassandra/PMML modules), and produce a short design note covering the multi-binder extension, HDFS HA proxy change, module-port strategy, REST contracts for U5/U6, and UI changes for U7/U8.",
      "most_likely_effort": 8
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A2",
      "activity_name": "U1 - Multi-binder support for same binding type",
      "activity_description": "Extend Spring XD binder configuration to allow multiple distinct external systems of the same binding type (e.g., two Kafka binders) per module. Introduce named binder references, update channel-to-binder resolution, and provide configuration syntax and validation.",
      "most_likely_effort": 22
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A3",
      "activity_name": "U2 - HDFS HA support for custom module location",
      "activity_description": "Modify the XD module-location loader so that when HDFS is the module location store and the namenode is configured for HA (dfs.nameservices in core-site.xml), it uses an HA-aware NameNode proxy. Update config parsing and add unit/integration tests against a simulated HA cluster config.",
      "most_likely_effort": 14
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A4",
      "activity_name": "U3 - Port Cassandra module from XD to s-c-s",
      "activity_description": "Move the Cassandra module source tree from spring-xd to spring-cloud-stream, realign package names, update Maven coordinates and dependencies, adapt to s-c-s module conventions, and verify sink behavior in a streaming pipeline (write/read integration test).",
      "most_likely_effort": 20
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A5",
      "activity_name": "U4 - Port analytic-pmml module from XD to s-c-s",
      "activity_description": "Port the analytic-pmml processor module from spring-xd to spring-cloud-stream, including PMML model loading, JPMML evaluator integration, and processor message mapping. Add tests covering a representative PMML model and verify use as a processor in a stream pipeline.",
      "most_likely_effort": 26
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A6",
      "activity_name": "U5 - REST endpoint for job composition flag",
      "activity_description": "Add a new Admin REST endpoint that returns a boolean 'composed' flag indicating whether a given job is a parent in a composed-job relationship or standalone. Update controller, DTO, and unit/integration tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 6
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A7",
      "activity_name": "U6 - REST endpoint for job composition graph",
      "activity_description": "Add an Admin REST endpoint that returns the job-composition graph (nodes and edges representing parent-child relationships) for a given composed job. Implement DTO, controller method, service-layer traversal, and tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 12
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A8",
      "activity_name": "U7 - UI visual differentiation for composed jobs",
      "activity_description": "Update the XD Admin UI job list/detail views to visually distinguish composed-job entries from standalone jobs (icon, color band, and/or label) using the new U5 flag and U6 graph data. Update Angular templates, controllers, and CSS.",
      "most_likely_effort": 10
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A9",
      "activity_name": "U8 - UI navigation fix for composed vs singular jobs",
      "activity_description": "Fix job-list navigation so that clicking a job entry routes to the correct detail page regardless of whether the entity is standalone or part of a composed job. Update UI routing, controller logic, and add UI tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 7
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A10",
      "activity_name": "Integration, end-to-end, and regression testing",
      "activity_description": "Run and extend integration tests covering multi-binder scenarios, HDFS HA module loading, the two ported modules in pipeline tests, both new REST endpoints, and UI smoke tests. Fix defects discovered during regression.",
      "most_likely_effort": 24
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A11",
      "activity_name": "Documentation updates",
      "activity_description": "Update reference docs: multi-binder configuration syntax, HDFS HA configuration, Cassandra/PMML module usage in s-c-s, the two new REST endpoints, and UI changes. Update changelogs and migration notes.",
      "most_likely_effort": 8
    }
  ],

    "most_likely_effort": 157
  }
}

technical_and_design_decisions: Target platform is Spring XD (eXtended Data) running on the JVM, with ported modules targeting the spring-cloud-stream (s-c-s) repository.
Reuse existing Spring XD module/options metadata model for the Cassandra and analytic-pmml modules to minimize behavioral drift during the port.

Implement multiple-bindings-per-type (U1) by extending the binder configuration model to allow named, distinct binder instances bound to the same input/output contract, with channel resolution at runtime.

For HDFS HA (U2), replace NameNodeProxies.createNonHAProxy with a HA-aware proxy that reads nameservice IDs from core-site.xml and uses HDFS HA RPC failover; keep the legacy non-HA path as a fallback.
Job-composition REST endpoints (U5, U6) are added to the Spring XD Admin REST controller layer using Spring MVC, returning JSON; U6 returns an adjacency-list representation of the composed job graph.
UI changes (U7, U8) are implemented in the existing XD Admin UI (AngularJS-based) and reuse the existing job-list/job-detail view templates; no new UI framework is introduced.
Testing strategy: JUnit + Mockito for unit tests, Spring XD test harness for integration tests, and Selenium-style smoke tests for the UI changes.
Build system assumed to be Maven (consistent with Spring XD/s-c-s conventions).
All eight user stories are independent and can be developed in parallel by a single developer sequentially; no cross-story refactoring is assumed unless explicitly noted (e.g., U5/U6 share a DTO).
No production deployment, infrastructure provisioning, or DevOps pipeline work is included in the scope.
assumptions: A single full-time developer performs all work; 1 work-hour equals 1 wall-clock hour of focused development.
Existing Spring XD source tree, s-c-s source tree, and CI infrastructure are available and not part of the increment.
Cassandra (U3) and analytic-pmml (U4) modules already exist in XD and are functionally stable; the work is a code move, dependency re-alignment, and re-test, not a re-implementation.
PMML evaluation engine (e.g., JPMML) is reused as-is in the ported analytic-pmml module; no new PMML features are added.
The job composition graph (U6) is bounded to a single composed job's direct parent/children and one level of nesting; recursive traversal is not required for the first increment.
The REST endpoints in U5/U6 are read-only; no mutation or composition management is included.
Visual differentiation in U7 uses color/iconography cues within the existing UI palette and does not require a new design system.
The 'detail page' referenced in U8 already exists for both standalone and composed jobs; U8 only fixes routing/navigation so the correct page is rendered from either entry point.
No production-grade performance testing, load testing, or security hardening is included beyond standard unit/integration coverage.
Code reviews, merging, and minor build fixes are folded into the per-activity effort rather than tracked separately.

activities.activity_description: Extend Spring XD binder configuration to allow multiple distinct external systems of the same binding type (e.g., two Kafka binders) per module. Introduce named binder references, update channel-to-binder resolution, and provide configuration syntax and validation.

activities.activity_name: U2 - HDFS HA support for custom module location
activities.activity_description: Modify the XD module-location loader so that when HDFS is the module location store and the namenode is configured for HA (dfs.nameservices in core-site.xml), it uses an HA-aware NameNode proxy. Update config parsing and add unit/integration tests against a simulated HA cluster config.

activities.activity_name: U3 - Port Cassandra module from XD to s-c-s
activities.activity_description: Move the Cassandra module source tree from spring-xd to spring-cloud-stream, realign package names, update Maven coordinates and dependencies, adapt to s-c-s module conventions, and verify sink behavior in a streaming pipeline (write/read integration test).

activities.activity_name: U4 - Port analytic-pmml module from XD to s-c-s
activities.activity_description: Port the analytic-pmml processor module from spring-xd to spring-cloud-stream, including PMML model loading, JPMML evaluator integration, and processor message mapping. Add tests covering a representative PMML model and verify use as a processor in a stream pipeline.

activities.activity_name: U5 - REST endpoint for job composition flag
activities.activity_description: Add a new Admin REST endpoint that returns a boolean 'composed' flag indicating whether a given job is a parent in a composed-job relationship or standalone. Update controller, DTO, and unit/integration tests.

activities.activity_name: U6 - REST endpoint for job composition graph
activities.activity_description: Add an Admin REST endpoint that returns the job-composition graph (nodes and edges representing parent-child relationships) for a given composed job. Implement DTO, controller method, service-layer traversal, and tests.

activities.activity_name: U7 - UI visual differentiation for composed jobs
activities.activity_description: Update the XD Admin UI job list/detail views to visually distinguish composed-job entries from standalone jobs (icon, color band, and/or label) using the new U5 flag and U6 graph data. Update Angular templates, controllers, and CSS.

activities.activity_name: U8 - UI navigation fix for composed vs singular jobs
activities.activity_description: Fix job-list navigation so that clicking a job entry routes to the correct detail page regardless of whether the entity is standalone or part of a composed job. Update UI routing, controller logic, and add UI tests.

Run and extend integration tests covering multi-binder scenarios, HDFS HA module loading, the two ported modules in pipeline tests, both new REST endpoints, and UI smoke tests. Fix defects discovered during regression.

Update reference docs: multi-binder configuration syntax, HDFS HA configuration, Cassandra/PMML module usage in s-c-s, the two new REST endpoints, and UI changes. Update changelogs and migration notes.
